faqs.question: Which Nothing Phone is best for gaming in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Phone 3 has the strongest current performance platform among the models covered, while Phone 4a combines a 120 Hz display, published 120 fps test claim and large vapour cooling system. Choose using the games, graphics settings, budget and sustained tests that matter to you.

faqs.question: Can Nothing Phone 4a run games at 120 fps?
faqs.answer: Nothing reports an average 116.7 fps in a 30-minute BGMI test using the game's 120 fps mode under its stated conditions. That does not guarantee 120 fps in every title, update, environment or Pakistan network session.

faqs.question: Can Nothing Phone 4b run games at 120 fps?
faqs.answer: Nothing advertises supported 120 fps gameplay, a 1,000 Hz touch-sampling claim and a 4,400 mm² cooling system. Exact game support, settings, temperature and software determine delivered performance.

faqs.question: Is Nothing Phone 3a good for gaming?
faqs.answer: Phone 3a uses Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 and a vapour chamber. Nothing reports an 88.7 fps BGMI average in a one-hour 90 fps test under its stated conditions, making it useful for moderate gaming when expectations are calibrated.

faqs.question: Does a 120 Hz screen guarantee 120 fps gaming?
faqs.answer: No. The screen can refresh up to 120 times per second, but the game, chipset, graphics preset, temperature and software must produce corresponding frames.

faqs.question: Why does gaming performance drop after 20 minutes?
faqs.answer: Sustained load raises internal temperature. The phone may reduce CPU, GPU or charging power to protect hardware, while battery state, ambient heat and network conditions can add further variation.

faqs.question: Should I charge a Nothing Phone while gaming?
faqs.answer: Charging and gaming together create additional heat. For demanding sessions, start with sufficient charge, use a compatible charger only when necessary, keep ventilation clear and stop if temperature becomes unsafe.

faqs.question: Does RAM Booster improve gaming FPS?
faqs.answer: RAM expansion uses storage to help retain apps; it is not physical RAM and does not turn a midrange GPU into a faster one. It may help multitasking but can also add storage activity.

faqs.question: How much storage should a gaming phone have?
faqs.answer: Large games, texture packs, recordings and updates can consume tens of gigabytes. A 256 GB model is safer for several major titles, while 128 GB can work with disciplined storage management.

faqs.question: Why is my ping high even when FPS is stable?
faqs.answer: FPS is local rendering performance; ping is network delay. Mobile signal, congestion, routing, server region, Wi-Fi interference and background traffic can raise latency independently.

faqs.question: Does a phone cooler improve Nothing Phone performance?
faqs.answer: A reputable external cooler may reduce surface temperature and slow thermal throttling, but condensation, blocked vents, pressure and poor accessories create risks. Never use moisture or extreme cold.

faqs.question: How should I test a used Nothing Phone for gaming?
faqs.answer: Run the exact game for at least 20–30 minutes, monitor frame consistency, touch, heat, battery drain, speakers and network, and inspect the battery, display and repair history before purchase.
